metadata.source: WSL SLF — measurement-data.slf.ch (IMIS, study plots) and EnviDat (GCOS SWE)
metadata.license: CC BY 4.0 (IMIS, study plots); ODbL 1.0 + DbCL 1.0 (GCOS)
metadata.attribution: WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF (www.slf.ch), CC BY 4.0
metadata.description: SLF IMIS automatic stations and manual study plots (daily snow depth), and the 11 GCOS sites (biweekly manual SWE, periodic). Codes are SLF-IMIS-<id>, SLF-SP-<id> and SLF-GCOS-<id>; slf_station_id holds SLF's own id.

properties.name: Mürren
properties.notes: GCOS SWE data from 11 stations in Switzerland, DOI 10.16904/15, licence ODbL-1.0 (database) + DbCL-1.0 (contents). Credit WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF (www.slf.ch) with a link to www.slf.ch.

data_variables.name: SWE
data_variables.description: Water equivalent of the snowpack, from a manual snow pit.
data_variables.notes: Manual, about every two weeks ('periodic'). gcos: column 'SWE(mm)'; new_snow: OBS-SWE-PROFILE. Returned in cm (× 0.1).

data_variables.name: HS
data_variables.description: Total depth of snow on the ground.
data_variables.notes: gcos: at the snow pit (biweekly); new_snow: fixed stake (daily); study_plot: manual morning reading (daily); imis: ultrasonic sensor — daily = median over the last 24 h, sub_hourly = 30-min instantaneous. Negative values are nulled.

properties.measurement_method: manual snow pit (SWE) and snow depth, ~biweekly
